source: Gólczewski, Lubiński and Chciałowski, Respiratory Research 2012, 13:57
cohort: Hope for Lungs, community screening at 93 Polish sites, 2002–2005; healthy never-smokers aged 18–85 with acceptable spirometry, sitting position, LungTEST1000. No bronchodilator intervention is described for these values.
quantities: Sex-specific observed arithmetic means and SDs in litres, rounded as published. No within-sex age or stature adjustment. Age and height are cohort descriptors.
uncertainty: Table 1 supplies participant SDs and sample sizes. It does not supply confidence intervals for the moments or the dependency, or individual observations. The output populations may include smokers or respiratory illness.
